destination.name: Taizhou
destination.tagline: A coastal Zhejiang hub with a city museum, an aquarium and a theme park
destination.description: Taizhou is a prefecture-level city on Zhejiang's coast, made up of Jiaojiang, Huangyan and Luqiao. In town, the Taizhou Museum covers local history and folk culture, and Taizhou Ocean World sits beside the citizens' square. A Fantawild theme park lies on the outskirts.
whyVisit: Explore local history and folk culture
Visit an aquarium and theme park

goodToKnow.title: On the high-speed line
goodToKnow.detail: Taizhou lies on the Ningbo–Taizhou–Wenzhou high-speed railway, so it suits a stop on a longer trip.

goodToKnow.title: Typhoons in summer
goodToKnow.detail: Summers are hot and humid, and typhoons occasionally strike. Check forecasts before a late-summer visit.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are milder than the hot, humid summers, when typhoons can strike the coast.
